deviations_from_card: (1) Component file is kit/FreshnessLine.tsx(+.module.css), not Freshness.tsx: on this case-insensitive disk './Freshness' resolved to freshness.ts and the component came back undefined. (2) Coupled files beyond the write set: data/paged.ts (Paged query must carry updatedAt to satisfy Query<T>; a paged list is as old as its oldest page), pages/brain/preflight.test.tsx and pages/review/layer1.test.tsx (each pinned the old copy 'Showing the last good reply'; one line each), app/shell.dom.test.tsx (the revision's regression assertion), budgets/bundle.json (lock taken). preflight.test.tsx carried slot A's uncommitted edits, so only my one-line hunk was staged via the index (git update-index), not the file. (3) aria-busy sits on a visually hidden status mark rendered beside the content while refreshing, not on a wrapper element: a wrapper would add a node on the live path and break child-combinator rules (simulator .overlay > [data-state], .root > :last-child). (4) DataLayer gains reopenedAt() and an optional now clock rather than a field on the connection snapshot (connection.ts was outside the write set). (5) 'connecting' before the first open counts as live, so the strip does not flash on every page load.
notes: Premise re-verified at HEAD: reopen still called retryFailed() only (error entries); Preflight still read layer.cache.getSnapshot. QueryView count at HEAD: 40 <QueryView> uses in 31 page files (37 in 29 at scout time). Switching the Refresh from ui/Button to a plain button cut l1 css growth from +1.9 KiB to +0.8 KiB. Committed tree: check-bundle 0 over.
